name: Loop Screenshot Studio
description: A configurable in-game screenshot utility with PNG export and clipboard support.

general-title.name: General
general-title.description: Main controls for Loop Screenshot Studio.

capture-key.name: Screenshot hotkey
capture-key.description: Press this while playing to capture the current Geometry Dash scene.

save-to-file.name: Save screenshot to a file
save-to-file.description: Save a PNG copy to your selected folder.

copy-to-clipboard.name: Copy screenshot to clipboard
copy-to-clipboard.description: Copy the captured image so you can paste it into supported apps.

output-folder.name: Screenshot folder
output-folder.description: Choose where Loop stores screenshots. Defaults to this mod's save directory.

resolution-title.name: Resolution & image quality
resolution-title.description: Choose the output dimensions and scaling behavior.

resolution.name: Output resolution
resolution.description: 4K is the default. Output above the game's rendered resolution is upscaled, not newly detailed.

custom-width.name: Custom width
custom-width.description: Used only when Output resolution is Custom.

custom-height.name: Custom height
custom-height.description: Used only when Output resolution is Custom.

scaling-filter.name: Upscaling filter
scaling-filter.description: Bicubic is smooth; Bilinear is softer; Nearest preserves hard pixel edges.

storage-title.name: File organization
storage-title.description: Customize how your screenshots are named and organized.

date-subfolders.name: Create a folder for each date

feedback-title.name: Notifications
feedback-title.description: Control on-screen feedback after a capture.

show-notifications.name: Show capture notifications
show-notifications.description: Show a small success or error notification after each screenshot.

technical-title.name: Technical information
technical-title.description: Loop captures the active Cocos2d game scene. It does not take a monitor screenshot. Very large outputs can use substantial memory.
